Looking for motivated teammates skilled in space science/research, game design, JavaScript/Canvas or Phaser, UI/UX, data visualization, and video/presentation. summary: Solar Watch is an interactive solar monitoring game that uses real NASA solar flare data, automatically updated through GitHub Actions. It combines real-world space science with engaging gameplay, helping players explore solar activity through real observations, simulated events, and predictions.
details:
Solar Watch – Survive Beyond Earth

Solar Watch is an interactive space survival and resource-management game inspired by NASA's challenge of establishing sustainable human settlements on the Moon and Mars.

Players take responsibility for maintaining a lunar or Martian outpost, where survival depends on carefully managing essential resources such as power, oxygen, food, life support, and radiation shielding. Every decision has consequences. Players must balance daily resource consumption, base maintenance, scientific activities, and protection against dangerous solar events to keep their astronauts alive.

What makes Solar Watch unique is its integration of real-world NASA solar activity observations. The game retrieves recent solar flare data from NASA's DONKI API through an automated GitHub Actions workflow. These observations provide a real scientific foundation for solar activity events within the game. Actual NASA observations remain clearly separated from simulated gameplay events and predictions.

The game aims to make complex space engineering challenges understandable and enjoyable, particularly for students aged 7–12. Through interactive survival mechanics, players experience how solar radiation can threaten astronauts and why resource planning, radiation protection, and reliable life-support systems are essential for long-duration space missions.

Technologies and tools used:

  • Python 3.12 for game development and logic.
  • NASA DONKI API for real solar flare observations.
  • GitHub for source-code hosting and data publishing.
  • GitHub Actions for automated data collection and updates.
  • JSON for storing and transferring solar activity data.

Solar Watch combines scientific authenticity, interactive gameplay, and educational storytelling to help players understand the challenges of humanity's future beyond Earth.
